Ein Telegrammschalter mit einem Messingg: A telegraph counter with a brass machine ticking quietly to itself. For a few coins you wire Inspector Marlowe in Kettlegate. She reads every file you send her and answers faster than you would think.
Der Streifen kommt ratternd aus dem Gerä: The tape rattles out of the machine. You can recognise Marlowe's manner even in telegram style.
